name: XXL-JOB Console
description: Manage XXL-JOB tasks, logs and executors with DBX built-in AI and MCP, scoped permissions and confirmed operation previews.
releaseNotes: 0.4.2 adds the explicit Admin 2.2.x profile, verified against official 2.2.0. Adapts jobCron and Cron preview while sharing workbench, AI/MCP and preview-confirmed writes. Hides unsupported scheduling choices and rejects incompatible parameters before preview. Keeps 2.3.x/3.4.x/3.5.x, scoped permissions and executor token protection. Select 2.2.x and /xxl-job-admin for a stock 2.2.0 deployment. Requires DBX 0.6.43+ and Host API ^1.4.0.
